data.name: Dungeon
data.detailed_description:
Welcome to the Dungeon

Dungeon is a First Person Shooter designed for those of us who miss the exploration and adventure from the Boomer Shooters of yore, it's filled with hidden rooms, zombies, as well as exciting secrets, Easter eggs, powerful weapons, challenging enemies and power-ups galore. Channeling all the fun aspects of 90's shooters, while the main character spits out one liners.

The Wrong Man, in the Wrong Place...

You play as John Grimm, a jaded soldier who escaped detention just to end up in ANOTHER kind of prison. Explore room after room, walking through endless, treacherous corridors full of mindless zombies, traps and other nasties, to uncover hidden rooms and discover secrets and Easter eggs, while you find the weapons to defeat all 5 powerful element-themed golems who hold the keys to your escape. You can just kill the golems and leave, or stay and unlock the secrets of the Dungeon, it's YOUR choice.

Your Choice, Your Gameplay

Every decision you make has consequences, and can lead to a different ending. Taking one path may close another, different playthroughs offer different relics or power-ups ensuring that each playthrough is a different experience. Will you rush through the Dungeon, seeking to defeat the bosses as quickly as possible, or will you take the time to explore every nook and cranny, uncovering secrets and hidden paths no one else has? The choice is yours.

The Arsenal

While you start out with a puny revolver, later on you can find weapons that border heavy artillery. From the brutal .75 Ga double-barrel shotgun, to the 20mm minigun and the plasma rifle, 7 in total, most weapons in this game are a powerhouse to be reckoned with.
With only 4 slots for weapons, managing your inventory is a key mechanic in this game, you choose when and where to use your weapons, ammo, mana and power-ups.
 

Like a Boss.

To progress, you'll need to defeat 5 powerful, element-themed bosses, to collect the keys they possess that allow you to unlock the portal that will take you out of this prison, and possibly home. Each boss with its own strengths and weaknesses, some downright invulnerable to part of your arsenal, some can be killed in two shots with the right weapon.

Game Features:

  • Immersive First-Person Shooter gameplay

  • Set in a dark fantasy, medieval Dungeon

  • Exploration-focused gameplay: The game emphasizes exploration over combat.

  • Manage your inventory and make strategic decisions about ammo and power-ups

  • Multiple endings based on your choices and actions

  • 5 element-themed bosses to defeat, each with its own strengths and weaknesses

  • 7 powerful weapons to find and collect and master

  • 6 different, element-themed areas to explore!

  • A mysterious hidden secondary character to aid or hinder your progress

  • Hidden rooms, secrets, Easter eggs and secret items, some of which only appear once in many playthroughs.

  • Inventory system: Players can manage their ammo and power-ups in an inventory system.

  • Power-ups and Mana: Power-ups can add mana/magic to the player's inventory for protection or ammo.

  • Lives system: You finish your lives, you’re finished (don’t worry, there’s plenty in the game)

  • Alt fire capabilities: Some weapons have alternative fire modes.

  • Inspired by classic, 90’s shooters

  • One-liners and humor

  • Your choices affect your gameplay, it’s all a big puzzle! 

 

Dungeon is a Labor of Love

Dungeon is a short, albeit heartfelt love letter to the 90’s kids and the 90’s devs I grew up with. Each room and each line of dialog were carefully crafted from scratch with pop culture in mind, maybe some references are a bit too obscure, but all in all I had fun working on Dungeon, and I genuinely hope you have as much fun playing it.

 

Wishlist Now and Stay Tuned for Updates!

I’m excited to share Dungeon with you, and I’m working hard to bring this awesome adventure to life. By adding the game to your wishlist, you will be the first to know when it launches, and you'll get exclusive updates on its development, if you want to know even MORE about it, consider following me on my social media!

data.short_description: Dungeon is a 90's style FPS where you play as John Grimm, a soldier trapped in a medieval dungeon filled with hidden rooms, zombies, and traps. Uncover secrets and Easter eggs while battling five powerful, element-themed bosses that hold the keys to your escape. Explore, fight, and choose your path!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: 7 and up
  • Processor: i5 13600K or AMD Ryzen 5 7600X
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: RTX 3070 or AMD Radeon RX 6700 X
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 16 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: 1080 native resolution, has low graphics settings to accommodate older systems, performs better with an SSD
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: 7 and up
  • Processor: i9 13900K or AMD Ryzen 9 7950X
  • Memory: 32 GB RAM
  • Graphics: RTX 4090 or AMD Radeon RX 7900 XTX
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 32 MB available space
  • Additional Notes: 1080 native resolution, performs better with an SSD
